Word Search Generator

Free word search maker

Turn your word list into a printable word search, with a separate answer page.

Everything runs in your browser; nothing you type is uploaded.

Your word search will show up here.

Spaces, hyphens, and numbers are removed before a word is placed. The list under the grid keeps the words as you typed them. Each placed word appears once.

Up to 40 words. Each word is 2 to 25 letters after cleaning, and no longer than the grid. A word that does not fit after 300 tries is skipped, and the reason is listed.

How to use

  1. Type words into "Words", one on each line or separated by commas.

  2. Leave →, ↓, ↘, and ↗ checked, or add the other directions, then press "New puzzle".

  3. Press "Print" for the puzzle and the answer, or "Download PNG" or "Download PDF" to save a file.

Example

A teacher pastes cat, dog, elephant, zebra, lion, hippo, ice cream, T-Rex into a 12 by 12 grid.

BeforeAfter
 
ice cream, T-Rex
ICECREAM and TREX are placed. The word list still shows ice cream and T-Rex.

FAQ

What happens to ice cream and T-Rex?

Spaces, hyphens, and other marks are removed, so those become ICECREAM and TREX in the grid. The list under the puzzle still shows the words you typed.

Why was a word left out?

It is longer than the grid, or it did not fit after 300 tries. The note names the word and tells you to make the grid bigger or remove it.

Can two words share a letter?

Yes, when the shared square is the same letter. Each of your words still appears only once in the whole grid.

Does the answer print on the same page?

Press Print. The puzzle is first and the answer grid, with boxes around the words, starts on the next page.
